'''AS-B07''' was a [[Courier droid/Legends|messenger droid]]. It resembled a small, floating black sphere, with a [[Comlink/Legends|transmitter unit]], and it could be used as a secure method for communicating information. One was given to the [[Heroes of Cularin]] by [[Culpharm]], as a reward for the heroes rescuing some Culpharm scientists.

==Behind the scenes==
AS-B07 appears in ''[[Forces of Cularin: Force Contention|Force Contention]]'', if the player characters succeed in rescuing the Culpharm scientists.
